description: MCP server exposing the Jabali Panel hosting control panel REST API as AI-assistant tools — domains, DNS, SSL, mail, databases, backups, cron, diagnostics.
rules: Start read-only; enable writes with JABALI_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1 only when needed
Destructive tools act only when re-called with confirm: true
Use a tenant (non-admin) API token unless the task requires admin
Never disable TLS verification; add a private CA via JABALI_CA_FILE
